description: A professional dermatologist-inspired routine to address hair fall and promote healthy hair growth.
estimated_time: 15-20 minutes per day, 30 minutes every week

morning_steps.action: Gentle cleansing with a mild shampoo containing biotin or keratin.
morning_steps.purpose: To remove any buildup and stimulate blood circulation in the scalp.

night_steps.action: Use a hydrating conditioner, focusing on the mid-lengths to ends of your hair.
night_steps.purpose: To lock in moisture and prevent protein loss that could lead to breakage and fall.

night_steps.action: Apply a leave-in treatment or serum rich in vitamins B, E, and A for extra nourishment.
night_steps.purpose: To provide additional support to the hair shafts and promote a healthy scalp environment.

weekly_steps.action: Deep conditioning treatment or scalp massage with an oil blend (e.g., argan, coconut) followed by a scalp mask.

expected_results.2_weeks: Reduced hair fall, improved scalp health
expected_results.3_months: Significantly reduced hair loss, healthier hair overall

expert_tips: Regular scalp massages can improve blood circulation
Balanced diet rich in proteins and vitamins supports hair growth
